pair_metrics.effect_sign_accuracy: fraction of non-tied true pair deltas whose predicted delta has the same nonzero sign
pair_metrics.effect_magnitude_mae: mean absolute error in pairwise utility delta
pair_metrics.kendall_tau_b: Kendall tau-b: C and D are concordant/discordant pairs; T_true counts every pair tied under true effects; T_pred counts every pair tied under predicted effects; tau_b=(C-D)/sqrt((n-T_true)*(n-T_pred)), with n=covered pairs. Ties on both sides count in both T_true and T_pred.
pair_metrics.top1_regret: best true utility in the frozen action bank minus selected action true utility, floored at zero
pair_metrics.null_false_effect_rate: fraction of covered pairs predicted nonzero when true scenario effect is identically zero

denominator_policy: emit per-metric defined episode count; null metric count=0; no confidence interval below two independent histories
